notes.title: Coming next Week: MacOS and Calendar Update
notes.content:
Hello! 



Coming next week:


🖥️ MacOS Release
Ithya: Magic Studies will officially be available on MacOS starting Tuesday, August 26th! Thank you to everyone who has been patiently waiting.


📅 Calendar Update
The Journal is receiving a major rework with the addition of a Calendar and a save system for habits, weekly notes, and daily notes. 

⚠️ Important: to ensure everything works smoothly with the new system, your current habits and weekly notes will be reset when the update goes live. Your notes in the notebook will not be impacted.


🎒 Back to School Event
Ithya: Magic Studies will also be part of the Back to School Event on Steam and will be available at a special promotional price during the celebration.

notes.title: Summer Content Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!



Summer has arrived in the world of Ithya! 🌞



Here's what's new:

12 new furniture pieces and 2 new walls to decorate your main room

2 new locations to explore and relax in

2 new playlists, perfect for focused or cozy summer sessions



Hope you enjoy this seasonal update! Thank you so much for your continued support. 💙

notes.title: Improvement Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Big update today with a lot of improvement that you suggested and some new content.
Thank you everyone for your support!

Here's the Update:

A new scene
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45315698/a150b0910e821fd96a43cacc2b18c56e091750ff.png

New playlist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45315698/6617b9fa962928adf9c893dcfef4c28b2e2b2977.png

5 new languages
- Spanish
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Italian
- German
- Thai
Support for Thai fonts in the journal

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45315698/fe396eccc10dc0f5e74752031c1f9447cdd9d095.png

Improved To-Do List
Drag and Drop to reorganize tasks!
Tasks are longer and allows more characters.
While editing a task - Pressing "Enter" create a new task, pressing "Backspace" delete the current empty task.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45315698/4a91908df2cdfd476fd64d6e8c6fef0083e2ecda.png

Improved Timers
Timer is now 3-digit with Hours, Minutes, Seconds
New! Stopwatch - gives passive XP every minutes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45315698/eb406c8b4ff1f7fd1ed2a6ccd3c82973ff4a4513.png

More Options
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45315698/993a77fb1c0138f955f2de876fbe87d0e1998902.png

A clock display in game. Activated in the advanced option.

For those who want to be rewarded only for their task complete and timed session, you can now disable passive XP.

For a complete focused session, you can also disable the Level Up notification.

For Streamers, a Tag for playlist has been added to indicate which playlist is safe for streaming.
It can be disabled in the advanced options.

Maximum Frame Rate selection and vSync option added in Advanced Option/Graphics.

Click on Sound icons to mute is now added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45315698/d8f95f089df72f6c090802b7a18f560f8d9592bc.png

A more robust saving and loading system has been added, with auto backup saves. This should prevent corrupted files and provide backup files, in case something went wrong.

Additional Fixes
- Night ambience sounds were mixed up with forest sound, it’s fixed.
- Elemental in the forest now cannot be clicked on if behind UI.
- Coins rewarded vs amount displayed in early level has been fixed
- Additional check for synchronizing Steam achievements added on start

notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.content:
A lot of improvement has been done!

Timers
- New alarm sounds
- Added slider to set alarm volume
- Alarm settings are now saved
- Timer can count up or down
- Timer can go up to 90 minutes

Tasks List
- Pressing enter while writing a task will now create a new task
- More XP given when completing a task

Journal
- Completing a habit in Habit Tracker now gives XP
- More lines added in the Note section

Home
- Parallax effect in home has been improved
- Larger clickable area to go left or right of the room
- Wall preview works on every walls

Bug Fix
- Chinese characters should now have consistent thickness when taking notes


If you encounter any bugs, you can report it in the discord: https://discord.com/invite/xgPUgxr7Au

Thank you!
